subject.title: feat: include provider/model/profile/trigger context in overloaded and rate limit error messages

question: Should transient provider failures shown in shared chat include provider/model/profile=active/trigger context, and must the refreshed branch preserve authMode before merge?
rationale: The authMode regression is mechanical, but the exact user-visible diagnostic fields are a product/privacy boundary for shared channels.

options.title: Refresh And Preserve AuthMode
options.body: Carry authMode, profileId, and trigger together through formatter, failover, payload, lifecycle, and runner call sites before any merge.

options.title: Narrow Delivered Diagnostics
options.body: Deliver only provider/model in chat and keep profile presence or trigger in logs/lifecycle metadata if shared-channel exposure is too broad.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Keep or close the PR later if maintainers decide transient provider context should not be added to core channel-visible copy.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Preserve AuthMode
recommendation.body: Carry authMode, profileId, and trigger together through formatter, failover, payload, lifecycle, and runner call sites before any merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current authMode contract that this PR overlaps and are the clearest owner from the inspected history.
